reason: The report uses a raw bivariate OLS with no controls, even though training is strongly correlated with pre-period firm characteristics (firm size, age, prior productivity 2020). When I added those 2020 controls, the coefficient fell from about 2.5 (untrimmed raw) to about 0.58, so the reported 2.165 is heavily confounded and overstated roughly fourfold. The outcome-based 1% trimming is also unjustified.
